# Regex

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A compiled regular expression. Matching uses Unicode by default and guarantees linear-time search without look-around or backreferences.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#regular-expressions).

## Compile

```PPL
Regex.Compile(STRING pattern, [RegexOptions options]) Regex
```

Static function.

Compiles a pattern with optional `RegexOptions`. An invalid pattern returns an invalid `REGEX` and sets `Error.Last()`.

## Escape

```PPL
Regex.Escape(STRING text) STRING
```

Static function.

Escapes all regular-expression metacharacters in literal text.

## Find

```PPL
Regex.Find(STRING text, [INTEGER start]) RegexMatch
```

Instance function.

Returns the first `RegexMatch` at or after the optional zero-based Unicode code point position.

## FindAll

```PPL
Regex.FindAll(STRING text, [INTEGER start], [INTEGER limit]) RegexMatch[]
```

Instance function.

Returns a `RegexMatch[]` at or after an optional zero-based start position. A positive limit restricts the result count; zero is unlimited up to 100,000. Negative limits or limits above 100,000 report an error regardless of the start position.

## IsMatch

```PPL
Regex.IsMatch(STRING text, [INTEGER start]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Reports whether the text has a match at or after the optional zero-based Unicode code point position.

## IsValid

```PPL
Regex.IsValid(STRING pattern, [RegexOptions options]) BOOLEAN
```

Static function.

Reports whether a pattern and optional options can be compiled without reporting an error.

## Pattern

`Regex.Pattern: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

The source pattern used to compile this regular expression.

## Replace

```PPL
Regex.Replace(STRING text, STRING replacement, [INTEGER limit]) STRING
```

Instance function.

Replaces all matches, or at most a positive limit, using `$1` and `$name` capture expansion.

## Split

```PPL
Regex.Split(STRING text, [INTEGER limit]) STRING[]
```

Instance function.

Returns a dynamic array of unbounded STRING values by splitting text. Empty fields are retained and a positive limit leaves the remainder in the final element.

## Valid

`Regex.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the regular expression compiled successfully.
